title: Extract shared Section type and modal props to types file
description: Section type is duplicated across Modal.tsx, AboutModal.tsx, ContactModal.tsx, etc. Extract to src/types/modal.ts with shared ModalContentProps interface.

title: Fix invalid CSS class hover:bg-slate-750 in ContactModal
description: ContactModal.tsx:37 uses hover:bg-slate-750 which is not a valid Tailwind class. Should be hover:bg-slate-700 or a custom color.

title: Add ARIA labels to icon-only buttons for accessibility
description: ProjectsModal.tsx:57-75 has icon-only Link/GitHub buttons that lack descriptive labels. Add aria-label attributes for screen reader accessibility.

title: Improve Modal accessibility with aria-describedby and better close button
description: Modal.tsx is missing aria-describedby for content description. Close button uses × character which may not announce properly. Add aria-controls to navigation tabs.

title: Replace array index keys with stable IDs in React lists
description: Multiple components use array indices as React keys which can cause rendering issues: ProjectsModal.tsx:26,38,47, ExperienceModal.tsx:49,60, SkillsModal.tsx:37, StaticPortfolio.tsx:114,126,135,193,242,253, CaptureModal.tsx:142

title: Extract magic numbers in game code to constants
description: Many hardcoded values throughout game code: background color in GameCanvas.tsx:75, proximity distance 50 in city.ts:300, animation timings in creatures.ts, door/window dimensions in buildings.ts. Extract all to constants.ts.

title: Remove or gate console statements for production
description: Console statements found in PortfolioContext.tsx:32 (console.error) and useBackgroundMusic.ts:40 (console.warn). Should be removed or gated for production builds.

title: Extract shared projectile logic to reduce code duplication
description: Arrow, Pokeball, and Hammer entities share similar patterns: movement updates, lifetime tracking, collision detection, cleanup. Create base projectile utility or factory to reduce duplication.

title: Add Error Boundary component to prevent app crashes
description: The app has no error boundaries. Unhandled errors can crash the entire application. Add an ErrorBoundary component wrapping the main app content.

title: Add utility functions for distance and collision helpers
description: Distance calculations and collision helpers are duplicated across multiple game files. Add to utils.ts: distance(pos1, pos2), createCollisionRect, createCollisionCircle, darkenColor, lightenColor.

title: Standardize resume file path across components
description: ExperienceModal.tsx:76 uses /resume.pdf while StaticPortfolio.tsx:268 uses /data/Hatzopoulos Alexandros Resume 2025.pdf. Should use consistent path.

title: Replace polling with event-driven updates in MobileControls
description: MobileControls.tsx:86-93 uses 100ms polling for action label updates. This is inefficient. Use event-driven updates instead.

title: Add modal exit animations for better UX
description: Modals disappear instantly on close. Add fade-out/scale-out transitions to match entrance animations. Currently only animate-fadeIn and animate-scaleIn exist.

title: Add React.memo to modal components to prevent unnecessary re-renders
description: Modal components re-render unnecessarily. Wrap AboutModal, ProjectsModal, SkillsModal, ExperienceModal, ContactModal with React.memo.

title: Add prefers-reduced-motion support for animations
description: Animations always play regardless of user preference. Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) checks in index.css to respect accessibility settings.
